WITH RankedLogs AS (
select buss_number, sum(part_need_num) part_need_num, part_code ,business_id ,sum(stock_num) stock_num, sum(purchase_num) purchase_num,sum(purchase_produce_num) purchase_produce_num,sum(produce_num) produce_num ,STRING_AGG(distinct batch_global_code::text ,',') batch_global_code_id , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY part_code, business_id, buss_number ORDER BY MAX(create_time) DESC ,MAX(id) DESC ) AS rn, max(id) id
from ${dispatchLogCount} a where enterprise_code=#{enterpriseCode} and product_flag=#{ data.productFlag } AND a.delete_flag = false
and buss_Number like '%' || #{ data.bussNumber} || '%'
and part_name like '%' || #{ data.productName} || '%'
and part_model like '%' || #{ data.productModel} || '%'
and stock_num>0
and purchase_num>0
and purchase_produce_num>0
and produce_num>0
and ( ${dynamicTableNameProxy.getXiHangPartQuery("a.part_code","xihang",data.partUnityNo)} or ${dynamicTableNameProxy.getXiHangPartQuery("a.product_code","xihang",data.partUnityNo)} )
and ( ${dynamicTableNameProxy.getProductPartSearchObj("a.part_code",data.searchName)} or ${dynamicTableNameProxy.getProductPartSearchObj("a.product_code",data.searchName)} )
group by part_code ,business_id ,buss_number
order by buss_number desc,max(create_time) desc
)
select * FROM RankedLogs WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY buss_number DESC ,id desc

and a.contract_number like '%' || #{ data.bussNumber} || '%'
and b.product_part_sign like '%' || #{ data.productName} || '%'
and b.model like '%' || #{ data.productModel} || '%'
